info.name: Java CoBan API
info.description:
# Full API Flow Checklist

Use this checklist when running the Java CoBan API collection. Run **Auth / Login** first and confirm `{{accessToken}}` is populated.

## 0. Auth
- [ ] Register a user when the environment has no login account yet.
- [ ] Login and store `data.access_token` into `{{accessToken}}`.
- [ ] Read current account with the bearer token.
- [ ] Logout after the run when needed.

## 1. Student
- [ ] Generate an available student code.
- [ ] Create student. The request pre-script calls `POST /api/v1/students/code` and injects `{{studentCode}}` before posting.
- [ ] Fetch students with paging/filter/sort.
- [ ] Get student detail by `{{studentId}}`.
- [ ] Update student profile fields.
- [ ] Export student CSV.
- [ ] Delete student when the test data is disposable.

## 2. Academic Foundation
- [ ] Create/list/update academic year.
- [ ] Create/list/update grade level.
- [ ] Create/list/update school class under the academic year and grade.
- [ ] Close/delete academic resources only after dependent enrollment, assignment, and class-subject data is no longer needed.

## 3. Semester, Subject, Class Subject
- [ ] Create/list/update semester.
- [ ] Activate, lock, reopen semester, then evaluate completeness decision.
- [ ] Create/list/update subject.
- [ ] Create subject applicability for GRADE and CLASS scopes.
- [ ] Create/list/update class-subject mapping.

## 4. Enrollment
- [ ] List unassigned students for an academic year.
- [ ] Create a single enrollment.
- [ ] List active class students.
- [ ] Read student enrollment history.
- [ ] Bulk create enrollments for multiple students.
- [ ] Transfer an enrollment to another class.

## 5. Teacher
- [ ] Create teacher.
- [ ] List teachers.
- [ ] Get teacher detail by `{{teacherId}}`.
- [ ] Update teacher.
- [ ] Delete teacher when no assignment depends on it.

## 6. Assignment
- [ ] List homeroom assignments by class.
- [ ] Create, replace, and end homeroom assignment.
- [ ] List subject teaching assignments by teacher.
- [ ] Create, replace, and end subject teaching assignment.

## 7. Negative/Validation Smoke Checks
- [ ] Try duplicate codes where unique constraints exist: student, academic year, grade, class, subject.
- [ ] Try invalid IDs and missing required fields.
- [ ] Try forbidden role/access scenarios when multiple tokens are available.
